dedupe_keys.name: lora and uav avalanche search and rescue radio measurements 2024 2025

description: This dataset measures LoRa signal strength and signal-to-noise ratio between a buried transmitter and a UAV-mounted receiver in avalanche search-and-rescue experiments. CNR researchers collected data at Col de Mez in the Italian Dolomites in April 2024, February 2025 and April 2025. Flights cover grid points, planned paths and larger search areas, with transmitter depth, UAV telemetry, reference positions and snow-profile documentation. Zenodo provides a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0; enclosed file formats were not established from the inventory. Coverage is one mountain plateau under selected wet and dry snow conditions. Site, antenna and burial arrangements are limitations for general rescue-performance claims. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating snow-attenuation or search-path assumptions in emergency-response simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related radio-network simulator, without a verified LoRa measurement adapter. No archive, UAV mission or localisation algorithm was executed.
name: LoRa and UAV avalanche search-and-rescue radio measurements, 2024–2025
